soundness_flags.label: Proposition 3 (parent reduction)
soundness_flags.one_line: The claimed exact bounded-d corner is false as written: the estimator definition equals the empirical-ratio estimator only when d<D_0, whereas a fixed bounded d≥D_0 enters the Jackson branch.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies the fixed-overlap high-dimensional discrete causal model for linear treatment-specific means; Theorem 2 gives a lower bound of order (d/(n log n))^2+1/n and explicitly leaves polynomial-estimator achievability open.

source_verification_receipts.version: IEEE Transactions on Information Theory 64(10), 2018; theorem text corroborated in arXiv:1705.00807v7
source_verification_receipts.locator: published pp. 6675–6678, Theorems 3 and 6; corroborating preprint pp. 4 and 7
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The unknown-unknown normalized L1 estimator has MSE O(S/(n log n)) under log n≤C log S, while the lower mechanism transfers from the known-Q experiment; these are not unrestricted all-regime causal-ratio results.
The paper gives a necessary-and-sufficient pathwise-differentiability condition for the optimal value and develops online inference, rather than a growing-alphabet minimax theorem.
The paper develops composite-hypothesis lower bounds and Hermite-polynomial estimators for a Gaussian nonsmooth absolute-value functional, including an asymptotically sharp constant result.

The paper estimates distributions up to permutation and symmetric discrete-distribution functionals using local moment matching; it does not preserve labelled four-tuples within causal covariate cells.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Correct Proposition 3 to state exact equality with the parent estimator only for d<D_0, or redesign the estimator so every fixed bounded alphabet uses the empirical-ratio branch.
State the n>d^2 lower-bound prior explicitly, including its overlap preservation, moment matching order, and target separation, rather than leaving the all-regime splice only as a proof mandate.
Give a finite-dimensional overlap-cone dual program or worked equal-propensity benchmark for the sharp-constant question.

recommended_next_step: Revise the parent-reduction sanity statement, then advance this field-tier estimation upgrade to Stage 0.

upgrade_review.upgrade_delta_one_line: The core supplies a named estimator with a stated uniform rate for the parent’s identical scalar target, plus a matching lower-bound target and an explicit parent corner.
